text: Well, work that mute pan on that wave for a few, few, few, huh? Pan on like a two-year-old. Let me tell you a fact. I'll be down down to Rick McBukin. I'll keep you full of holes and a full of flops. You hear me, don't you? Now, get in. Get up again. Water, water, water. And hold on to the sea. Oh, God.
